use: One-time development diagnostic on a separate, nonadjacent recording. No outputs or model code were used to author targets. Release inputs only after inference settings freeze. Never use these rows for training or tuning during this comparison.
source_split: EMT official train archive; Task 2 and Task 1 development recording
acquisition: Bounded compressed slices from the public training archive, TAR header checksums, full JPEG bytes verified against the published Task 1 frame SHA-256.
geometry: 2560x1440 original pixels. Hand-specified coarse plausible visible surface rectangles. No pixel mask, clearance, legality or claim of physical stop feasibility.
metrics: Retain every requested ID, missing/error/invalid/stale scene as failures. Exact status counts and confusion matrix, proposal coverage/wrong proposals, point in original author rectangle and normalized point error on paired finite outputs, rectangle IoU, fixed same-image contrast cases and clarification response. Include bright/dark and relative-side observations only as qualitative diagnostics.
